Revenue trends softened: quarterly revenue declined to $72.8K from $90.9K year‑over‑year; six‑month revenue also fell to $146.9K from $176.5K.
Gross profit remained positive (quarter: $55.9K; six‑month: $111.8K), indicating continued profitable unit economics for the company's closed‑loop payment solutions.
Operating costs, including G&A and depreciation & amortization, decreased materially versus the prior year, narrowing operating losses.
Operations remain focused on deploying FinTech/PayTech closed‑loop payment solutions through subsidiaries Tendercard and Deb and strategic technology partnerships.
Management indicated a need for additional financing to fully execute growth plans, which could affect the pace of scaling operations.
